perf: skip hash property

verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: The PR changes __hash__ to cache the comparison key in _key_cache, but __eq__ (inherited from _BaseVersion) still compares self._key == other._key. The base class's __hash__ used self._key, implying _key is a property that computes the key. The new __hash__ bypasses that property, so an unpickled object (which has _key_cache == None and never had __hash__ called) will compare unequal to a freshly constructed object whose __hash__ has populated _key_cache. This breaks pickling compatibility, an unintended regression.
